summary: Rabbi Besser explores the spiritual lessons of the Akeidat Yitzchak and the life of Sarah in Parashat Hayei Sarah. He discusses the significance of the word 'Hineni' and the concept of living up to one's potential, while also examining the connection between the Akeida and the blowing of the shofar on Rosh Hashanah.
questions: What is the meaning of the word Hineni?
Why do we blow the shofar on Rosh Hashanah?
Why is the parasha named Hayei Sarah if it begins with her death?
What is the significance of the small letter chaf in the word 'lifchota'?
